sonnet.problem: This True statement mostly repeats card 11, which already asked what the Twelve do when they leave a place that won't welcome them (shake the dust off their feet). It re-asks the same fact, and the card before it has just given away the answer.
sonnet.rule: A True statement never just repeats the card before it. ... An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact. Two lines that make the same point get one question.

sonnet.problem: The line 'they don't just say a word and walk off' adds a claim about how the healing was done. Mark 6:13 says nothing like that. It only says they healed many of the sick, anointing them with oil.
sonnet.rule: Don't stretch the text. Exaggerate only in his own jokes.

sonnet.problem: 'Jesus' own hometown just took offense at Him, so now He's going from village to village' ties the two events together as cause and effect. Mark 6:6 says only that Jesus went around the villages teaching.
sonnet.rule: Leave open what the text leaves open. Who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.
